messages:
kevin-partnerships: Heads up — APAC marketplace vendor 'NoriCloud' reporting PO uploads rejected. Procurement says their system rejects POs where currency is sent as 'JPY' but our EDI stream sometimes emits 'JP¥' (unicode yen). Can someone confirm?

maria-finance: ugh. we started seeing a batch of invoice rejects at 06:12 JST. can you paste an example PO?

kevin-partnerships: pasted from partner: ```<PurchaseOrder><Total currency=\"JP¥\">150000</Total></PurchaseOrder>``` system log: `400 Bad Request - unsupported currency code`

sam-engr: ack. our EDI transform has a currency normalizer but it only handles ascii codes. looks like some partners send symbol instead of ISO code. i can add a fallback map (JP\u00A5 -> JPY). need sample list though.

marketplace-bot: automated-reject: PO 2026-AP-4523 rejected by apac-gateway: currency_unrecognized (payload contains non-iso-code)

josh-sales: this is blocking the reseller onboarding — NoriCloud can't accept sales until POs clear. Partner is pushing for an ETA.

anya-legal: legal note: we have a redline in the reseller MSA that says billing currency must be ISO-4217 code. temporary mapping ok, but record it and surface to contracts team. audit trail required.

maria-finance: temporary workaround idea: accept the upload and normalize currency to JPY on ingestion, mark original payload in audit logs. finance side ok with that if audit is preserved and GL posts use JPY.

sam-engr: plan: add a small sanitizer step in the EDI pipeline which normalizes common symbol->ISO. I can push a hotfix to staging today. patch: ```diff
+    if not is_iso_currency(code):
+        code = symbol_map.get(code, code)
``` ETA: deploy to staging in ~3h, prod after smoke tests (~6h).

kevin-partnerships: thank you. can you also add a monitoring alert for 'currency_unrecognized' so we can spot other partners sending weird payloads?

sam-engr: yes — will add a Datadog gauge and an alert (rule: >5 rejects / 5m).

anya-legal: please log both original payload and normalized value for 7 years (per APAC compliance ask).

maria-finance: confirm GL posting will use normalized code; i'll add a note to billing runbook.

josh-sales: i'll tell NoriCloud the workaround and give a conservative timeline (EOD deploy + morning confirmation). they asked for a written note we fixed on our side.

kevin-partnerships: copy. @sam-engr please drop the staging link and brief steps once deployed so I can forward to the partner. :thumbsup:

sam-engr: will do. staging URL: https://staging-marketplace.internal/po-uploads (run ingest test -> check /api/v1/ingest/logs). I'll post results here when done.

marketplace-bot: deploy pipeline: hotfix/edi-currency-fallback merged. CI green. scheduled deploy to staging at 3:15 UTC.

kevin-partnerships: awesome — thanks everyone. will follow up after staging verification and legal/finance confirm audit retention.
